Team, you all know that I have been doing my podcast since 2016 - holy moly, it’s been 10 years!!!!!!! I have gone from recording audio only to recording on a $30 microphone in my first New York City apartment. I have gone all over the world to interview guests, and now I have my very own beautiful white studio! … The piece I care about most is the brain. Your deepest sleep is when the brain washes itself out, and part of what it clears is the amyloid and tau that build up in Alzheimer’s. A glass of wine before bed shreds that stage.
